application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey lower ground floor wraparound extension; replacement upper ground floor outrigger extension; replacement windows; installation of heat pumps; and associated works
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9ec10a7b-7fff-5573-f226-11c076158b94"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed rear extension, by reason of its excessive height, depth, and positioning immediately adjacent to the northern shared boundary with No. 59 Ufton Road, would result in an unneighbourly and overbearing form of development. The extension would breach the 45-degree line of sight, resulting in a loss of light and outlook, and would result in an overbearing extension for the occupiers of No. 59 Ufton Road. As such, the proposal is contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020 and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2026).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e026d1c3-7fff-321d-6bbd-516550896462"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed lower ground floor wraparound extension, by reason of its size, scale, form, and detailed design, would infill the historic side gap and obscure the traditional rear outrigger projection, eroding the established urban grain pattern along the terrace. The proposal would result in harm to the architectural integrity of the host property and fails to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the De Beauvoir Conservation Area. No public benefits have been identified that would outweigh the level of harm caused. The development would thus conflict with policies D1 (London's form, character and capacity for growth), D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of The London Plan, policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets), and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations S</span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">PD 2026. </span></p>
